Differential Calculus — Chain Rule

Chapter 2: Triple Nested Logarithmic Function | Page 33

Home Work 22
Problem Statement Nested Logarithm Chain Rule
Find the derivative with respect to xxx of the function:
y=log⁡(log⁡(log⁡x))y = \log(\log(\log x))y=log(log(logx))
STEP 1 প্রদত্ত ত্রি-স্তর যৌগিক লগারিদম ফাংশনটি উল্লেখ করি (Given Triple Nested Function)
y=log⁡(log⁡(log⁡x))y = \log(\log(\log x))y=log(log(logx))
STEP 2 উভয়পক্ষে xxx-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ অপারেটর প্রয়োগ করি (Applying Differentiation Operator w.r.t. x)
dydx=ddx[log⁡(log⁡(log⁡x))]\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{d}{dx}\left[ \log(\log(\log x)) \right]dxdy​=dxd​[log(log(logx))]
STEP 3 সর্ববহিঃস্থ লগারিদমের জন্য চেইন রুল প্রয়োগ করি (Differentiating Outermost Logarithm)
dydx=1log⁡(log⁡x)⋅ddx[log⁡(log⁡x)]\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\log(\log x)} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}\left[ \log(\log x) \right]dxdy​=log(logx)1​⋅dxd​[log(logx)]
STEP 4 মধ্যবর্তী লগারিদমের জন্য চেইন রুল প্রসারিত করি (Differentiating Intermediate Logarithm)
dydx=1log⁡(log⁡x)⋅1log⁡x⋅ddx(log⁡x)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\log(\log x)} \cdot \frac{1}{\log x} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(\log x)dxdy​=log(logx)1​⋅logx1​⋅dxd​(logx)
STEP 5 সর্বঅভ্যন্তরীণ log⁡x\log xlogx-এর অন্তরজ নির্ণয় করে গুণফল আকারে সাজাই (Differentiating Innermost Logarithm)
dydx=1log⁡(log⁡x)⋅1log⁡x⋅1x=1xlog⁡xlog⁡(log⁡x)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\log(\log x)} \cdot \frac{1}{\log x} \cdot \frac{1}{x} = \frac{1}{x \log x \log(\log x)}dxdy​=log(logx)1​⋅logx1​⋅x1​=xlogxlog(logx)1​
FINAL ANSWER dydx=1xlog⁡xlog⁡(log⁡x)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{x \log x \log(\log x)}dxdy​=xlogxlog(logx)1​

📘 Box 1: Mathematical Foundations & Formula Reference
  • Triple Chain Rule Layering: Let u=log⁡(log⁡x)u = \log(\log x)u=log(logx) and v=log⁡xv = \log xv=logx. Then y=log⁡uy = \log uy=logu. dydx=dydu⋅dudv⋅dvdx=1u⋅1v⋅1x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{du} \cdot \frac{du}{dv} \cdot \frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1}{u} \cdot \frac{1}{v} \cdot \frac{1}{x}dxdy​=dudy​⋅dvdu​⋅dxdv​=u1​⋅v1​⋅x1​
  • Standard Logarithmic Derivative: ddt[log⁡t]=1t\frac{d}{dt}[\log t] = \frac{1}{t}dtd​[logt]=t1​.
  • General nnn-fold Nested Logarithm: For y=log⁡[n](x)y = \log^{[n]}(x)y=log[n](x), dydx=1x⋅log⁡x⋅log⁡(log⁡x)⋯log⁡[n−1](x)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{x \cdot \log x \cdot \log(\log x) \cdots \log^{[n-1]}(x)}dxdy​=x⋅logx⋅log(logx)⋯log[n−1](x)1​.
⚠️ Box 2: Common Student Traps & Pitfalls
  • Nested Logarithm vs. Power of Logarithm: log⁡(log⁡(log⁡x))≠(log⁡x)3\log(\log(\log x)) \neq (\log x)^3log(log(logx))=(logx)3. The derivative of (log⁡x)3(\log x)^3(logx)3 is 3(log⁡x)2x\frac{3(\log x)^2}{x}x3(logx)2​, which is entirely different!
  • Dropping Intermediate Factors: Jumping straight from the outer log to 1x\frac{1}{x}x1​ without including 1log⁡x\frac{1}{\log x}logx1​.
  • Order of Factors in Denominator: Conventional standard is writing in ascending complexity: xlog⁡xlog⁡(log⁡x)x \log x \log(\log x)xlogxlog(logx).
🌐 Box 3: Real Domain & Differentiability Analysis
  • Innermost condition: x>0x > 0x>0.
  • Middle condition: log⁡x>0  ⟹  x>1\log x > 0 \implies x > 1logx>0⟹x>1.
  • Outermost condition: log⁡(log⁡x)>0  ⟹  log⁡x>1  ⟹  x>e≈2.71828\log(\log x) > 0 \implies \log x > 1 \implies x > e \approx 2.71828log(logx)>0⟹logx>1⟹x>e≈2.71828.
  • Strict Real Domain: Domain=(e,∞)\text{Domain} = (e, \infty)Domain=(e,∞).
  • Differentiability: Infinitely differentiable and monotonically increasing on (e,∞)(e, \infty)(e,∞).
💡 Box 4: Explicit Substitution Method (ধাপে ধাপে চলক প্রতিস্থাপন)
  • Let u=log⁡x  ⟹  dudx=1xu = \log x \implies \frac{du}{dx} = \frac{1}{x}u=logx⟹dxdu​=x1​
  • Let v=log⁡u  ⟹  dvdu=1u=1log⁡xv = \log u \implies \frac{dv}{du} = \frac{1}{u} = \frac{1}{\log x}v=logu⟹dudv​=u1​=logx1​
  • Then y=log⁡v  ⟹  dydv=1v=1log⁡(log⁡x)y = \log v \implies \frac{dy}{dv} = \frac{1}{v} = \frac{1}{\log(\log x)}y=logv⟹dvdy​=v1​=log(logx)1​
  • Multiplying the three rates of change: dydx=dydv⋅dvdu⋅dudx=1log⁡(log⁡x)⋅1log⁡x⋅1x=1xlog⁡xlog⁡(log⁡x)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{dv} \cdot \frac{dv}{du} \cdot \frac{du}{dx} = \frac{1}{\log(\log x)} \cdot \frac{1}{\log x} \cdot \frac{1}{x} = \frac{1}{x \log x \log(\log x)}dxdy​=dvdy​⋅dudv​⋅dxdu​=log(logx)1​⋅logx1​⋅x1​=xlogxlog(logx)1​
